description:
List the time blocks of a day's timeline (Day view), in timeline order. A block is either an activity (type 'block') or a task bucket (type 'tasks' — shows the day's untimed tasks, or what its filter selects: `filter_tag_id` = one page, `filter_due` = due dates; null = the day's tasks). The meta carries the day's raw timeline_order: "b:<uuid>" refs are blocks, bare uuids after a bucket are the order the user chose for its tasks.

Recurring blocks: listing today or a future day first creates that day's recurring blocks if they do not exist yet (same as opening the day in the app), so every block returned has a real id you can update or mark done. A block that repeats carries `repeats: { recurring_block_id, weekdays }` (ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); otherwise `repeats` is null. Past days are never filled in afterwards.

Notes: each block carries `notes` ([{ id, title, content }], real Keepsake notes linked to the block — prepared before, completed after), `note` (the first note's text) and `entry_id` (the short entry that tells the block, created by the app's "Add details" or by create_entry with day_block_id; null if none). A recurring block also carries `kept_notes` (same shape): notes kept by its repetition, shown on every occurrence from the day they were kept (see keep_recurring_block_note) — `notes` and `note` are that day's own notes only.

People and pages: each block carries `contact_ids`, `company_ids` and `tag_ids` (the people, companies and pages it is about — e.g. a meeting with Romain about a project). They are an agenda intention, not history: a contact's timeline does not list blocks; the entry created by "Add details" carries the block's people and pages.
name: list_day_blocks
